text: The subject is Arslan Ghani, who holds account PK**HABB****1319 opened on 3 March 2025. The subject declared an occupation of Student with a monthly income of PKR 20,000 per month. Between 2 May 2026 and 11 May 2026, the account recorded 16 credits totalling PKR 960,000 and 4 debits totalling PKR 847,000. The credits consisted of 16 interbank (IBFT) transfers received from 13 distinct senders. An alert was raised by Tazama on 11 May 2026, where Tazama typology MULE-01 scored 360 against an alert threshold of 300. The receipt of funds from 13 distinct senders is indicative of money mule activity. Debits equal to 88% of credits, with a median of 4.7 hours between the latest credit and each debit, are consistent with suspected money mule activity. Credits in the activity window were 48.0 times the declared monthly income of PKR 20,000 per month for a Student, which is inconsistent with the customer profile and indicative of money mule activity. The note by Fraud Desk on 10 May 2026 states that two sender banks raised fraud recall requests against inbound transfers to this account, citing scam complaints, which is consistent with suspected money mule activity. The activity, including credits 48.0 times the declared monthly income of PKR 20,000 per month from 13 distinct senders for a Student, is consistent with suspected money mule activity. PKR 572,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI) in 2 transactions. PKR 275,000 was withdrawn as Cash (ATM) in 2 transactions. There was no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media screening on 29 May 2026. The note by L2 analyst on 12 May 2026 indicates that outgoing wallet transfers were placed on hold pending review.
